_comment: DLO -> DMO field mapping for Attended_Games. Base names only (no __c); apply_dmo.py resolves each source to the DLO's actual field developer name (case-insensitive base match against the live DLO) and each target to <target>__c. SOURCE = Snowflake BASEBALL.WAX_BASEBALL.FCT_ATTENDED_GAMES (the mart renames several columns vs the old BigQuery raw table: game_date, venue_wax, away_team_name, *_id_wax). Targets are the DMO fields in attended_games_dmo.json (unchanged); the SDM measures read [Attended_Games].[Wax_Game_ID]/[Venue]/[Game_Date] via those DMO fields.
